topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers
description: First / youngest / longest PM/President + notable facts

questions.stem: The first PRIME MINISTER of independent India was:
questions.explanation: Nehru — India's first PM, 15 August 1947 to 27 May 1964 (died in office). Three-term, longest-serving PM. Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the first PRESIDENT of India. Gandhi never held constitutional office.

questions.topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The YOUNGEST person to become Prime Minister of India was:
questions.explanation: Rajiv Gandhi — sworn in at 40 years, on 31 October 1984 after his mother's assassination. Indira was 49. (Rajiv's tenure: 1984-1989. Youngest among ALL Indian PMs.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The first DALIT to become President of India was:
questions.explanation: K. R. Narayanan — 10th President (1997-2002) — first Dalit President. Ram Nath Kovind was the 14th, also a Dalit. (Zakir Husain — first Muslim President; Droupadi Murmu — first tribal-origin President, 2022.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Match the PM with their NOTABLE ACTION. A. Lal Bahadur Shastri.  B. Morarji Desai.  C. V. P. Singh.  D. P. V. Narasimha Rao. List-II: 1. 1965 war slogan 'Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan'.  2. First non-Congress PM, 1977.  3. Implemented Mandal Commission, 1990.  4. Led 1991 LPG reforms.
questions.explanation: Shastri — 1964-66, 'Jai Jawan Jai Kisan'. Desai — first non-Congress PM (Janata Party, 1977-79). V.P. Singh — 1989-90, Mandal reservation for OBCs (27%). Rao — 1991 reforms with Manmohan Singh as FM.
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: Who was the FIRST VICE-PRESIDENT of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan — VP 1952-1962, went on to become the 2nd President (1962-67). Dr. Rajendra Prasad was 1st President. V. V. Giri was 4th President (1969-74). Zakir Husain — 3rd President (1967-69, first Muslim).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
questions.topic: Prime Ministers & Presidents of India — mixed tiers

questions.stem: The Indian President who died IN OFFICE was:
questions.explanation: Zakir Husain — 3rd President, died 3 May 1969 while in office. VP V. V. Giri acted, then was elected 4th President (1969-74). (PM Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed, 5th President 1974-77, is the OTHER President who died in office — useful trivia trap.)

questions.stem: Which PM served for the SHORTEST tenure in India?

options.option_text: Gulzarilal Nanda (13 days × 2 as acting PM)

questions.explanation: Vajpayee held office from 16 May 1996 to 1 June 1996 — 13 days — resigned after failing to prove majority. Gulzarilal Nanda was ACTING PM for 13 days twice (after Nehru's death, after Shastri's death), but not a substantive PM. (Vajpayee had two more long tenures: 1998-99 and 1999-2004.)
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Droupadi Murmu — 15th President of India (2022-) — is the FIRST:
questions.explanation: Droupadi Murmu — first person from a tribal (Santhal) community to become India's President. She is also the 2nd woman President after Pratibha Patil (2007-2012). Youngest President at oath (64). Former Governor of Jharkhand (2015-2021).
